description: Get one published listing by id. Owner contact is not included. weeklyPrice is the low end of the posted price converted to USD per week, and is null when the price is invalid. priceQuality is ok, unusual, or invalid (null when no price is posted). Treat unusual or invalid prices as unverified: do not quote them as typical, pass along priceNote, and suggest confirming with the owner. likelyJobAd marks job posts, which are not rentals.
name: get_listing
